611:t_020:2.en:
$$アマタ$$
「Is that battleship's power behind this...?」

611:t_020:3.en:
$$トライア$$
「The $$ソーラリアン$$ is nothing more than a control system. The source of its power is all the different feelings you've experienced in your battles until now.」

611:t_020:4.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「The $$Ｚクリスタル$$ is those feelings refined into a high-purity crystal. In other words, it's like a battery that condenses the power of life.」

611:t_020:5.en:
$$トライア$$
「The $$Ｚチップ$$ that AG provided us during the $$時空修復|lc$$ in the $$時獄戦役$$... I've kept up my research on it all this time, and it has finally taken shape.」

611:t_020:6.en:
$$シモン$$
「Now there's nothing left that can stop us!」

611:t_020:7.en:
$$竜馬$$
「From here on, it's strength against strength!」

611:t_020:9.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「That is exactly what we wanted, isn't it, General $$ダバラーン$$?」

611:t_020:10.en:
$$尸刻$$
「The battle has only returned to where it began... Then all that remains is to show the Earthlings the might of the Empire.」

611:t_020:11.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「...Precisely! The real contest starts here!」

611:t_020:13.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「$$デンゼル$$, $$トビー$$, $$マルグリット$$, $$ツィーネ$$, please serve as the $$ソーラリアン$$'s close escort.」

611:t_020:14.en:
$$デンゼル$$
「Understood! The ship carrying humanity's hope... I'll protect it no matter what!」

611:t_020:15.en:
$$トビー$$
「You heard him! Leave the $$ソーラリアン$$ to us!」

611:t_020:16.en:
$$マルグリット$$
「The rest of you, focus on the attack!」

611:t_020:17.en:
$$ツィーネ$$
「Let me see it. The power of you all, who broke the secret of $$クロノ$$ that was guarded for hundreds of years.」

611:t_021:0.en:
$$トライア$$
「Using the power of the $$Ｚクリスタル$$, this $$ソーラリアン$$ can perform event control just once per minute.」

611:t_021:1.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「A total of 6 kinds of event control are set up, and they correspond to the $$Ｚクリスタル$$'s GRADE!」

611:t_021:2.en:
$n
「So the higher the $$Ｚクリスタル$$'s GRADE, the more kinds of event control we can use!」

611:t_021:3.en:
$$トライア$$
「It's not as if it can do anything amazing, but if you master it, your tactical options should widen.」

611:t_021:4.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Leave the operating to yours truly... AG!」

611:t_021:5.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Understood! We'll put that power to use!」

611:t_022:0.en:
$$トライア$$
「All right, time for a fresh start, $c!」

611:t_022:1.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Even the Chief has played her trump card. This is truly an all-out war.」

611:t_022:2.en:
$$ランド$$
「Let's do this! We'll break through here in no time, and then it's on to the imperial capital, $$ラース・バビロン$$!」

611:t_022:3.en:
$$セツコ$$
「We won't stop! Not until we've liberated Earth!」

611:t_023:1.en:
$$タケル$$
「Now no one is left to block our road to $$ラース・バビロン$$.」

611:t_024:0.en:
$$万丈$$
「Even some reassuring reinforcements have come for us on the eve of the decisive battle.」

611:t_024:1.en:
$$桂$$
「It feels wrong to call it a side note, but we've also started to see how to deal with the collapse of the universe that comes once every 120 million years.」

611:t_024:3.en:
$$オルソン$$
「If the collapse of the universe is a kind of spacetime disaster, then returning spacetime to a stable state may be able to prevent it.」

611:t_024:4.en:
$$葵$$
「But for that, we'd need three keys... three $$特異点$$s, wouldn't we?」

611:t_024:6.en:
$$桂$$
「Exactly. Let me introduce them once more.」

611:t_024:7.en:
$$桂$$
「The third $$特異点$$, Miss $$ツィーネ・エスピオ$$.」

611:t_024:8.en:
$$ツィーネ$$
「It's not like I chose to become one, though.」

611:t_024:9.en:
$$桂$$
「The detonation of the $$時空震動弾$$ that caused the $$大時空震動$$, the start of today's unstable spacetime...」

611:t_024:10.en:
$$桂$$
「She was there at the scene too, just like me and $$オルソン$$.」

611:t_024:11.en:
$$ロラン$$
「Then can these three return the world to its state before the $$大時空震動$$?」

611:t_024:12.en:
$$ツィーネ$$
「Unfortunately, it isn't that simple.」

611:t_024:13.en:
$$ガロード$$
「What the heck! I got my hopes up for nothing!」

611:t_024:14.en:
$$トライア$$
「That's because the current multiverse is a complex tangle of all sorts of factors.」

611:t_024:15.en:
$$トライア$$
「Unless we find the core of that knot... the so-called $$大特異点$$, I'd say a $$時空修復|lc$$ is out of the question.」

611:t_024:16.en:
$$アスラン$$
「Isn't that $$ユニウスセブン$$ of the $$ＵＣＷ$$?」

611:t_024:17.en:
$$トライア$$
「That functioned as a $$大特異点$$ when the world called the $$ＵＣＷ$$ was repaired.」

611:t_024:18.en:
$$トライア$$
「But to stop a spacetime collapse that affects every parallel world in today's multilayered structure, we'd need a singularity that runs through all the worlds...」

611:t_024:19.en:
$$トライア$$
「We'd need to find the so-called $$超特異点$$, I'd say.」

611:t_024:22.en:
$$トライア$$
「I have no idea at the moment.」

611:t_024:23.en:
$$桂$$
「But once we find it, the power of the three of us $$始原の特異点$$s should make a $$時空修復|lc$$ possible.」

611:t_024:24.en:
$$オルソン$$
「If this so-called great collapse, once every 120 million years, weren't coming, there'd be no need to force a $$時空修復|lc$$ in the first place.」

611:t_024:25.en:
$$ノノ$$
「But signs of a mass outbreak of $$バアル$$ have been confirmed.」

611:t_024:26.en:
$$バスターマシン７号$$
「But signs of a mass outbreak of $$バアル$$ have been confirmed.」

611:t_024:27.en:
$$ダイバスター$$
「But signs of a mass outbreak of $$バアル$$ have been confirmed.」

611:t_024:28.en:
$$レド$$
「In the galactic center, the battle between them and humanity has already begun.」

611:t_024:29.en:
$$レド$$
「And if humanity is defeated, the universe will...」

611:t_024:30.en:
$$トライア$$
「That's enough. It's the way of the world that you get tripped up when you only look at what's ahead.」

611:t_024:31.en:
$$トライア$$
「Even a debt of 1,000,000 G gets paid off by saving 1 G every day, over and over. Right, $$クロウ$$?」

611:t_024:33.en:
$$クロウ$$
「But the assault on $$ラース・バビロン$$ is too heavy a mission to compare to 1 G.」

611:t_024:34.en:
$$アムロ$$
「$$エルーナルーナ$$, $$尸空#pilot$$, $$バルビエル$$... And on top of that, the power of $$皇帝アウストラリス$$, whom we have yet to see...」

611:t_024:35.en:
$$セツコ$$
「Which emotion his $$立ち上がる射手$$ $$スフィア$$ is sourced from, and how much power it holds, is completely unknown.」

611:t_024:36.en:
$$メール$$
「But doesn't that seem odd? In the battle at $$インダストリアル７$$, the Emperor didn't show up in a machine.」

611:t_024:37.en:
$$ランド$$
「The machine was probably on board $$エルーナルーナ$$'s ship.」

611:t_024:38.en:
$$スズネ$$
「All the answers will be revealed at $$ラース・バビロン$$.」

611:t_024:39.en:
$n
「And whatever is waiting for us there, we'll just keep moving forward.」

611:t_024:40.en:
$$オズマ$$
「Reports of Earth-side victories keep coming in from the fronts everywhere.」

611:t_024:41.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「It seems that the revelation of $$クロノ$$'s doctrine has given people not despair, but anger to stand up and fight.」

611:t_024:42.en:
$$バナージ$$
「So humanity isn't as weak as $$フル・フロンタル$$ and $$クロノ$$ think.」

611:t_024:43.en:
$$トライア$$
「That's because of you... because $c exists.」

611:t_024:45.en:
$$トライア$$
「It's the same as during the $$時空修復|lc$$ in the $$時獄戦役$$. Your existence is what gathers people's hope.」

611:t_024:46.en:
$$トライア$$
「And the world we have now is a world born from denying the $$時の牢獄$$.」

611:t_024:47.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「A world where people wished for a future...」

611:t_024:48.en:
$$シモン$$
「So we're the ones running at the head of it.」

611:t_024:49.en:
$$號$$
「That's right. We have now become the very future of humanity.」

611:t_024:50.en:
$$號$$
「If we lose, it will close off the future of all humanity.」
